pollution_risk: Low. The subject is NTFS reparse-point (junction / symbolic link / mount point) safe traversal and deterministic audit. It does not overlap the other Windows tasks in this batch (wacl, wads, wencoding, wfmt, winstall, wpathext, wpipe, wport, wproc, wps, wreg, wreserved, wrotate, wscan, wstamp, wsync, wtask), which cover ACLs, alternate data streams, encoding, formatting, installers, PATHEXT, pipes, ports, processes, PowerShell modules, registry, reserved device names, log rotation, directory scanning, timestamps, sync and task scheduling. External exposure review is not required because no upstream repository or third-party asset is included.
authorization: No external repository or third-party asset is included. All fixtures are generated locally by environment/prepare.ps1.
